en: How do I save a customer segment?

steps: Contacts > Customer segments: type a name, set the rules (any tags, all tags, orders, last wrote to us, or everyone), press Show the count, then Create the segment
Edit opens the segment in the same form; Save the change
Delete shows what is kept and asks you to type the segment name before Delete the segment
Campaigns > audience lists the saved segments
edgeCases: Owner only: staff do not see the panel and the server answers 403
Deleting a segment does not delete customers or campaigns already made
Opted-out and no-consent customers are always left out of a segment's audience
A segment id from another workspace answers 404
